description: Erection of marketing hoarding along the site boundary to promote the upcoming development.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The non-illuminated advertisement hoarding hereby approved shall be erected for a limited period lasting the duration of the construction period for the development approved under planning reference 01689/D/P7.
Condition : 2 - No advertisement or hoarding is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.
Condition : 3 - Any advertisement or hoarding displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.
Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 5 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity.
Condition : 6 - The advert hereby approved shall not contain any illumination and shall be retained without illumination thereafter.
